text: Entry 2082 removes comments that said placeholder From/To values survive mime_sanity_check_fields. Tests still pass placeholder compose fields while queueing a prebuilt message. The DSN test separately explains that X-Mozilla-Draft-Info controls DSN. Fixed SendLater builds fresh compose fields from the stored author and parsed recipient headers, then reads DSN from draft info before calling SendMessageFile. Keep queue-time API input separate from the fixture values tested at later delivery, and state that reason in test setup comments. The source confirms this path; it does not prove every sender-validation rule or a successful SMTP transaction. No tests were run.
